data.name: Khuddam
data.gender_notes: Khuddam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who serves or follows, often used to refer to a servant of Allah or a follower of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Khuddam carries the meaning “Servant, Follower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khuddam usually hope their child will grow to embody servant, follower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who dedicate their lives to serving and following Allah, embodying the qualities of devotion, loyalty, and selflessness.
data.etymology: Khuddam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant, Follower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khuddam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: خُدَم
in_arabic.long_meaning: الخُدَمُ: الأَصحابُ المُخلصونَ لِلرَبِّ، المُعَوَّدونَ في طاعَتِهِ، المُتَوَكَلونَ عَلَيْهِ في كُلِّ شَيءٍ، المُرتَضونَ لِفِعْلِ الخَيْرِ، وَالمُذَكِّرينَ لِلرَأيَ في كُلِّ عَمَلٍ، وَالأَذَلُّونَ لِلرَبِّ، وَالأَرزَقُ لَهُ، وَالأَمانُ لَهُ

in_urdu.name: خُدَم
in_urdu.meaning: خُدَم: اللگے ہوئے بندے جو اللہ کے ساتھ وفادار ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: خُدَم: اللگے ہوئے بندے جو اللہ کے ساتھ وفادار ہیں، اللہ کی اطاعت کے لیے پریشان ہوتے ہیں، اللہ پر اعتماد رکھتے ہیں، نیک کاموں کے لیے ممدوح ہیں، ہر کام میں ان کی رائے کا سمجھوتا ہے، اللہ کے سامنے ان کی ذلت ہے، ان کا رزق اللہ ہی ہے، اور ان کا بچاؤ اللہ ہی ہے

in_hindi.name: खुदम
in_hindi.meaning: खुदम: वफादार बने हुए लोग जो अल्लाह के साथ हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: खुदम: वफादार बने हुए लोग जो अल्लाह के साथ हैं, अल्लाह की इबरत के लिए परेशान होते हैं, अल्लाह पर विश्वास करते हैं, नेक कामों के लिए प्रशस्त हैं, हर काम में उनकी राय का समझौता होता है, अल्लाह के सामने उनकी धैर्य है, उनका भरण-पोषण अल्लाह ही करता है, और उनका बचाव भी अल्लाह ही करता है

in_pashto.name: خُدَم
in_pashto.meaning: خُدَم: د الله تهلو لرونکی اوسیدلئی
in_pashto.long_meaning: خُدَم: د الله تهلو لرونکی اوسیدلئی، په د الله له اطاعت کښلی پرښلی، الله ته مخک کښلی، الله ته پوهنګ درلودلی، نیکو عمليوں ته مخک کښلی، هر کار کښلی په الله ته رائې درلودلی، الله ته ورونه کښلی، الله ته د غذا ورکړنګ کښلی، او الله ته د ممانعتو ورکړنګ کښلی

in_english.name: Khuddam
in_english.meaning: Khuddam: devoted servants of Allah who are sincere and loyal
in_english.long_meaning: Khuddam: devoted servants of Allah who are sincere and loyal, committed to the obedience of Allah, reliant on Allah in every matter, reminded by Allah in all actions, favored by Allah in every deed, humbled before Allah, nourished by Allah, and protected by Allah

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khuddam" holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic community as it is a term used to describe a person who is devoted to serving and following the teachings of Allah and the guided path of Prophet Muhammad. It is a name that signifies a deep sense of dedication and loyalty to Islam. Khuddam are often seen as role models and sources of inspiration in their communities, and their selfless service and commitment to their beliefs are a powerful testament to the enduring influence of Islamic values and teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Khuddam" represents an individual's unwavering commitment to Allah and His Prophet. The term reminds us of the importance of serving and following Allah's commands, and of striving to live a life that is pleasing to Him. In a deeper sense, the name "Khuddam" also highlights the fundamental Islamic belief that every believer has a role to play in the larger community of believers, and that serving and helping one another is a key component of living a faithful and fulfilling life. Ultimately, the name "Khuddam" serves as a reminder of our ultimate goal as Muslims: to be true servants of Allah and to seek His pleasure in all that we do.
